description.1341:
DMDroid is cold DM outreach automation for Instagram, built for SMMA owners, agencies and coaches who acquire clients through Instagram.

Import target lists from any source, build multi-step message sequences with minimum 5 variants per step and A/B testing, and let auto follow-ups run until prospects reply. Volume spreads across 10+ connected accounts (500+ people a day) with every account under ~50 sends a day in its own isolated browser session, protected by rate caps, sending windows and heartbeat monitoring.

Every reply lands in a unified visual pipeline (DM'd, Initiated, Engaged, Calendly, Booked) with per-account analytics, so no warm lead slips. DMDroid runs on your machine, on your VPS for 24/7 operation, or fully hosted with Done-For-You where we run everything and you just reply.

Solo Operator ($69/mo, 1 account) for operators; Agency (from $106/mo, 2-30 accounts) for teams and client work. Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial.
description.2192:
DMDroid is cold DM outreach automation for Instagram, built for SMMA owners, agencies and coaches who acquire clients through Instagram outreach.

The core idea: manual DM outreach dies on follow-up. DMDroid imports your target lists, builds multi-step sequences with minimum 5 message variants per step (rotated so no account ever sends the same DM twice), and follows up automatically until prospects reply. Volume spreads across 10+ connected accounts for 500+ people a day, with every account under ~50 sends a day in isolated browser sessions guarded by rate caps, sending windows and heartbeat monitoring.

What it is for:
- Agencies running client acquisition on Instagram at scale
- SMMA owners selling lead generation as a repeatable service
- Coaches and operators replacing VA sending and manual follow-up
- Teams that need a visual reply pipeline instead of inbox chaos

What it deliberately is not: an inbound comment-to-DM bot, a multi-channel giant, or a cloud black box. DMDroid runs on your machine or VPS (or fully hosted Done-For-You), sends from your own accounts, and stops every sequence the moment someone replies.

Solo Operator is $69/mo for one account. Agency starts at $106/mo for 2-30 accounts with volume discounts. Done-For-You is custom: hosting, setup and management included. Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial.
